title: senna tapajozensis
intro: Senna tapajozensis, commonly known as the Brazilian senna, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues such as constipation and diarrhea due to its purgative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna tapajozensis include laxative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Senna tapajozensis include anthraquinones, such as aloe-emodin and chrysophanol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
